# DECISIONS — Architecture and implementation decisions

## D001 — Manual project scaffolding instead of Astro CLI
**Reason:** Astro CLI `npx create astro` ran interactively and timed out in the CI-like environment.
**Decision:** Manually created all files following Astro 4 project structure exactly.
**Impact:** Identical result; lockfile generated by `npm install` step.

## D002 — CSS design tokens instead of Tailwind CSS
**Reason:** Blueprint specifies "Tailwind CSS or scoped CSS with design tokens." Vanilla CSS with custom properties gives maximum control over the Obsidian Cyber Command Center aesthetic without build-time class purging complexity.
**Impact:** All styling in `src/styles/tokens.css` and `global.css` — zero runtime overhead.

## D003 — Static SVG poster as primary hero visual
**Reason:** Blueprint requires "static poster/SVG" as the first visual, with WebGL as progressive enhancement. Ensures content is usable without JS/WebGL.
**Decision:** CSS-animated SM shield + orbit rings + particles as poster. Three.js scene loads lazily over it.

## D004 — No contact form
**Reason:** Blueprint explicitly states "Default version-এ message form থাকবে না" because backend-less delivery is unreliable.
**Decision:** LinkedIn link as primary contact, mailto when owner provides email.

## D005 — Publication-state filtering at data layer
**Reason:** Blueprint mandates `draft`/`review`/`published`/`archived` states. Build must only render `published` content.
**Decision:** `publishedOnly()` utility in `types.ts` called in every data file. Empty arrays auto-hide their sections.

## D006 — Sections auto-hide when empty
**Reason:** Blueprint: "যে section-এ verified data নেই, সেই nav item এবং section দুটোই hide হবে."
**Decision:** Each section component checks its data and returns early if empty. Nav items statically included but can be removed once owner confirms hidden sections.

## D007 — Google Fonts via @import (fallback to self-host later)
**Reason:** Initial build uses Google Fonts CDN for Manrope + IBM Plex Mono to avoid font subsetting complexity at launch. Self-hosting to be done pre-production for performance and privacy.
**Impact:** Note in performance budget; swap before final deploy.

## D008 — Terminal whitelist implementation
**Reason:** Blueprint: "eval, shell API, remote API বা arbitrary HTML injection নিষিদ্ধ"
**Decision:** String enum of commands, all outputs are static TypeScript arrays. `textContent` used (not `innerHTML`) for user-visible output. Input sanitized before display in command echo.
